startUrls.title: Search result start URLs
startUrls.description: Full housing.com search-result-page URLs to start from, e.g. https://housing.com/in/buy/udupi/manipal-gid/ . One URL per locality/city search. Only 'buy' (sale) SRP URLs are supported by this actor.

maxPagesPerStartUrl.title: Max pages per start URL
maxPagesPerStartUrl.description: Maximum number of paginated result pages (?page=N, 30 cards/page) to crawl per start URL.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Hard cap on total page requests across all start URLs (politeness / cost control).

minRequestDelaySecs.title: Min delay between requests (seconds)
minRequestDelaySecs.description: Minimum politeness delay before each page navigation.

maxRequestDelaySecs.title: Max delay between requests (seconds)
maxRequestDelaySecs.description: Maximum politeness delay before each page navigation (a random value between min and max is used).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxy group is strongly recommended - housing.com's WAF blocks datacenter IPs.
